title: ShieldLabs webhook.ping event
description: Body of a `webhook.ping` delivery, sent when you verify an endpoint. It has no `data`. The keys arrive sorted alphabetically and `created_at` has second precision.

created_at.description: When the ping was sent, with second precision.

Rfc3339Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with up to 9 fractional digits (trailing zeros trimmed), for example `2026-09-30T12:34:57.482913041Z`. Parse it with a parser that accepts nanoseconds.

SchemaVersion.description: Webhook contract version. Current release 2026-10-06; parsers also accept legacy 2026-06-01.
